_about: The kit capacity contract (docs/ux-system/kit-v2.md §8.6), read by test/kit/kit_capacity_test.dart and its shards. For every exported kit part: its role, which sets its maximum painted width (roles[role].maxWidth, a token resolved in test/kit/kit_capacity_contract.dart; a part's own maxWidth overrides it); each text slot's overflow rule, keyed by its words as the gallery scene writes them (wrap, ellipsis:N, fade:N, scroll; clip:N and visible:N are recorded but are violations); and each list-like field's rule beyond what fits (grows, wraps, scroll, more, page, fixed with shows, not-items; unknown is a gap, allowlisted). minTarget is the smallest tap target in dp (kit-v2 §8.3). Text slots are recorded with KIT_CAPACITY_WRITE=1; review the diff.

chip.why: Chips, pills, tags and inline values: hug their words, at most 320 dp, then ellipsize.

confirm.why: A confirmation: 560 dp on a medium window, a 480 dp dialog wider up (kit-v2 §8.2).

control.why: One button or one compact control: hugs its label, never wider than 400 dp, so a primary action on a PC is not a 1,500 dp bar.

conversation.why: Transcript and composer parts: the conversation column's cap (LAY-5), about 70 characters of body text, the prose measure.

dialog.why: A dialog (alert, short input): 480 dp, inside Material 3's 560 dp dialog maximum (kit-v2 §8.2).

fill.why: Fills the region its caller gives it by design: a screen, a bar, a full-screen viewer or layer, a divider. The caller's region carries the cap.

glyph.why: Icons, marks, rings, avatars, meters: a fixed small size; 96 dp is the ceiling for the largest (a 56 dp FAB, a 64 dp ring).

lane.why: A board lane and its cards (KitBoardLane.md, LAY-2).

list.why: Rows, lists, tables, code and logs: a list on its own, wide enough for a row's value at the far edge without losing the eye.

popover.why: Menus, term bubbles and tips: a popover; Material 3 menus are 112–280 dp, the kit allows 200–320 (KitMenu.md D2).

reading.why: Prose, cards, notices, forms and their controls: the reading measure (65–75 characters at body size).

sheet.why: A bottom sheet: Material 3's 640 dp maximum, centred; on a wide window it becomes a dialog panel (560) or side sheet (≤480), both inside this cap.

state.why: A page state (empty, error, working): a short centred column (KitStateView.md).

toast.why: The undo bar / snackbar: 480 dp from a medium window up (KitUndo.md, kit-v2 §8.2); Material 3 snackbars cap at 600.

wrapper.why: Takes its child's size (motion, focus, scroll, selection, direction wrappers); the child's own cap applies.
